desc: 墨黑台面石膏白台座加一点柠檬，6500K正前高硬光八屏奶瓶详情
kw: 黑白柠檬高反差详情页
leaf: 蛋形磨砂半透瓶身亮面宽颈环高透明圆顶罩盖奶瓶
name: 墨黑台面石膏白柠檬方标宽口奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用一整面哑光墨黑加一条石膏白纸弧与方台座、正前高硬光一次交代蛋形磨砂瓶身、亮面宽颈环与高透明圆顶罩盖的装配关系，全场只留一点柠檬做序号，靠极端明度反差抢到首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上方黑色留白带左对齐放一条冷白主标与一行柠檬副标，主标下一条 #8A8D92 发丝横线，其左端一枚带白色描线序号码的柠檬方块

shots.intent: 把源图里三条复制成同一句「适合各个年龄」的灰块图位和三枚同名重复图标，改成墨黑台面上三张完全空白的石膏白纸板和三枚柠檬序号方块，条目文字全交给占位符，不杜撰任何适用人群与功效
shots.textZone: 顶部黑色带一条冷白小标题与一行柠檬副标，其下一行三枚柠檬序号方块，三张白板各留一条空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图三段复制成同一句材质科普与三层材质罗列改造成同面墨黑里用一条柠檬规则线划开的两栏无值对照，左栏整块石膏白留白给卖家自贴、右栏立本品，杜绝杜撰对比与材质等级
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照小标题与一行柠檬副标，两栏各一条空白标签位，序号挂在两枚柠檬方块上

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代高透明圆顶罩盖、顶端小凸点、亮面宽颈环与环下窄封圈的装配台阶，把源图「真空奶瓶」「高清漆」两条杜撰结构引线改为只撑结构不写机理的空白标签
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行柠檬结构小标题，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 正侧90度交代蛋形磨砂瓶身、圆弧底与罩盖高度比例，把源图三处自相矛盾的容量与材质规格数字全改成一条无字尺寸轨加三行空白引线，任何数值都不落地
shots.textZone: 左侧一条无字尺寸示意轨，右侧三行空白标签线挂在柠檬小方块上，顶部一行冷白造型小标题

shots.intent: 把源图只有灰块占位与「在家用手柄提升抓握」的无实物暗示，改写成一处墨黑暗角看护场景：成人从肩下取景不露脸、被抱的婴儿只出背影、奶瓶由成人手持且罩盖始终在位，让买家代入又不越安全边界
把源图产品信息表里互相对不上号的规格行与材质行、以及三枚重复图标，改成正俯视石膏白档案纸上两支配色并列与六行字段名数值全空的档案轨加一整块留证位，任何事实都不由模版落地
shots.textZone: 顶部一条档案小标题与一行柠檬副标，其下六行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），底部一整块空白留证位与一枚柠檬序号方块

shots.intent: 以三十度俯角在墨黑台面与石膏白纸弧边收口整套黑白柠檬视觉，留一枚空白行动卡与两行空白标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上方黑色留白带放结束标题、一行柠檬副标、一枚空白行动卡与两行空白标签线，底部一行三枚柠檬序号方块与一条发丝线

style.backgroundSystem: one deep matte black studio field throughout: a velvety near-black #0B0B0C table with a fine mineral-dust tooth and no reflection, out of which one broad sheet of chalk #F2F1EE paper sweeps up from behind the table edge and curves over to form the only backdrop element, its single clean curve reading as a bright arc cut out of the black; the product stands on one crisp rectangular chalk #F2F1EE plinth block with a hard sawn front edge and a visible paper-thickness seam; flat infographic screens place their content on a chalk #F2F1EE paper sheet laid squarely on the black table with one hard corner, one hairline #8A8D92 rule and one thin lemon #F3D943 band marking the active column, and one solid graphite #17181B reversal block for knocked-out copy; scene screens read the same language as a calm dark interior corner with a charcoal #17181B wall meeting one chalk #F2F1EE surface and nothing else; never a limewash plaster arch or niche, never a white paper sweep carrying the black blocks (this set is always black ground with white objects, never the reverse), never a printed technical grid or graph paper, never a stone or micro-cement slab, never bed linen, muslin or a fabric basket, never a timber shelf, plank or tabletop, never a ceramic or square-tiled wall with grout joints, never a podium disc or tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a glass sheet or water-line studio, never a pastel colour-block wall

style.lightingSystem: one hard cool studio key at about 6500K placed high and just off the lens axis toward camera left at roughly 45 degrees above the sight line, so the light reads as front-above rather than from any side: every object throws one short, dense, sharply bounded shadow that falls back and toward camera right and pools tightly under the front edge of the plinth; the clear dome overcap carries one broad bright highlight across its top-front and one narrow specular on its upper-left flank, the glossy collar ring one tight hot highlight on its near-left rim, the frosted body a smooth graded falloff into its shadow side with no separate rim light and no second source; one small chalk #F2F1EE card low at camera right lifts only the deepest pool directly under the base so the black table keeps reading as black and never lifts to grey; contrast high, colour temperature cool-neutral in every screen, no fill anywhere else; never a camera-right side rake, never a shoulder-height horizontal key, never a long stretched or raked shadow, never a pure overhead geometric-cutter shadow field, never a backlit rim-only set-up, never a soft wraparound envelope of light, never a warm or amber cast

style.presentationRules: the short egg-shaped frosted bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the chalk plinth with the tall clear dome overcap fitted over the wide glossy collar ring and the nipple fully seated and secured inside the dome in every screen; the egg-to-pear body silhouette from shoulder flare down to the rounded base, the base radius, the dome height, the small nub at the apex of the dome, the wide collar ring and the narrow darker seal band directly beneath the ring are never redrawn, resized, simplified or relocated; the reference set carries exactly two collar-ring colourways, one warm-toned and one cool-toned, each keeping its own reference tone, and no third colourway may be invented or named in words; no graduation or measuring scale is visible on the frosted body in the reference, so none is drawn, added, extended or implied anywhere in the set; no handle, grip loop, straw, spout, valve, vent or weighting part appears in the reference, so none may be invented on any screen; any printed motif on the body front keeps its exact reference placement and scale while all wording inside the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn text; the product never floats, always keeps its tight contact shadow plus its short dense cast shadow to camera right, is never occluded by props or by a leader line, vertical lines stay strictly vertical, and one real unmarked chalk #F2F1EE block or sheet stays in every scene shot to anchor scale honestly
style.surfaceSystem: the matte black table and the chalk paper sheet as the only standing surfaces, plus the chalk #F2F1EE plinth block whose top face carries a real fine paper-fibre tooth and whose front edge is a hard sawn line; the frosted bottle body renders as true diffusion with the inner nipple faintly readable through it, the clear dome and the nipple render as true refraction and real elastomer with soft internal shading, the glossy collar ring as a soft satin sheen with a readable step edge, and the narrow darker seal band at the neck keeps its own reference tone; the product settles with visible weight onto the plinth so one tight dark contact shadow sits directly under the rounded base and the chalk surface stays matte with no mirror reflection, no gloss floor, no wet surface and no droplets
